rows.note: This is the all-purpose spoken construction for saying that a body part or wound has inflammation.

example.english: My eye has inflammation and keeps watering.
example.traditional: 我隻眼有發炎，成日都流眼水。
example.jyutping: ngo5 zek3 ngaan5 jau5 faat3 jim4 seng4 jat6 dou1 lau4 ngaan5 seoi2

rows.note: Use this noun mainly in medical, technical, or written contexts rather than everyday conversation.

example.english: The doctor diagnosed the patient with chronic inflammation.
example.traditional: 醫生診斷病人患有慢性炎症。
example.jyutping: ji1 saang1 can2 dyun3 beng6 jan4 waan6 jau5 maan6 sing3 jim4 zing3
